rows.grounds: compound eka-eka-aṃśa-vihīna; instrumental form indicating successive reduction by one part
indeclinable numeral adverb indicating division into nine ways or measures
compound sakala-udaya; the full extent or rise as the object of measurement

items.question: By what graduated reduction is the complete rise divided into nine measures?
premises: The complete rise constitutes the full extent to be measured.
This extent is articulated in a ninefold division.
Each successive measure is diminished by one part.
items.inference: The complete rise is systematically apportioned into nine measures, each reduced by one part in sequence.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic role of sakalodayam depends on the governing verb implied from the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: The complete rise is measured ninefold, each time diminished by one part.
